operator.label: Operator
operator.definition: Human authorized to configure, approve, reset, commit, publish, or pin governed data.

project.label: Project
project.definition: Governed SAGE identity for one Scripture or Paratext/PTLite project, independent of workflow role.

job.label: Job
job.definition: Persistent governed BIC or SAW binding of SAGE Projects and workflow roles.

run.label: Run
run.definition: Bounded operation and Scripture scope under one Job.

paratext_project.label: Paratext Project
paratext_project.definition: Project directory containing USFM and its project-local custom.vrs when applicable.

projects_root.label: Projects root
projects_root.definition: Paratext projects directory containing eng.vrs, org.vrs, and project folders.

operation.label: operation
operation.definition: Public workflow action requested by the Operator.

work_unit.label: work unit
work_unit.definition: Internal bounded subdivision of one Operator scope.

packet.label: packet
packet.definition: Exact serialized evidence for one work unit.

context_only_evidence.label: context-only evidence
context_only_evidence.definition: Adjacent evidence supplied for interpretation but excluded from ordinary finding locations.

structure_policy.label: structure policy
structure_policy.definition: Governed USFM marker classes and boundary scores used for work-unit planning.

poetry_block.label: poetry block
poetry_block.definition: Body span introduced or separated by a governed poetry boundary such as qa or b.

target_generation.label: TARGET generation
target_generation.definition: Immutable committed BIC project snapshot selected by exact generation ID.

bic_source.label: BIC SOURCE
bic_source.definition: The sole BIC content and translation authority; formal binding CONTENT_SOURCE.

bic_donor.label: BIC DONOR
bic_donor.definition: A lexical/vocabulary donor only; formal binding LEXICAL_DONOR. It never supplies BIC content authority.

bic_target.label: BIC TARGET
bic_target.definition: The generated-project write destination; formal binding GENERATED_TARGET. Existing target Scripture is not BIC input evidence.

saw_wip.label: SAW WIP
saw_wip.definition: The work-in-progress translation being analyzed by SAW; formal binding `WIP`.

saw_reference.label: SAW REFERENCE
saw_reference.definition: The configured LWC Reference Project comparison used by SAW; formal binding `REFERENCE`.

pass.label: pass
pass.definition: One isolated model-analysis pass inside an operation.

task.label: task
task.definition: One governed runtime unit executed through the provider-neutral sealed task interface.

report.label: report
report.definition: Human-facing output artifact derived from governed Job data.

equivalence_group.label: equivalence group
equivalence_group.definition: Resource-local coordinates that map to the same canonical semantic span.

finding.label: finding
finding.definition: Supported RTC conclusion, primarily used by SAW.

challenge.label: challenge
challenge.definition: Translation difficulty or unresolved decision, primarily used by BIC.

language_profile.label: language profile
language_profile.definition: Canonical language-code namespace selected by a project.

profile_variant.label: profile variant
profile_variant.definition: Optional role-specific guidance selected inside a language profile.

grammar_contract.label: grammar contract
grammar_contract.definition: Content-addressed compact rules derived from the project-selected language-profile variant.

derived_output.label: derived output
derived_output.definition: Reproducible generated data that is not authority.

content_state.label: content state
content_state.definition: Explicit trust and mutability flag: LOCKED or UNDER_REVIEW; never inferred.

project_role.label: project role
project_role.definition: Explicit authorized Project use declared in scope.roles; never inferred.

local_evidence_boundary.label: LOCAL EVIDENCE BOUNDARY
local_evidence_boundary.definition: Closed Job/task perimeter in which all content-bearing evidence must be governed SAGE-local evidence explicitly routed by exact path, hash, role, scope, and evidence class.

authorized_content_evidence.label: AUTHORIZED CONTENT EVIDENCE
authorized_content_evidence.definition: SAGE-local evidence authorized to support content judgments only within its exact Job role and bounded scope.

general_linguistic_competence.label: GENERAL LINGUISTIC COMPETENCE
general_linguistic_competence.definition: Model orthographic, morphological, grammatical, and syntactic competence used to understand or express routed evidence; it is not content evidence and may not introduce unsupported content.

experimental_unstable.label: EXPERIMENTAL / UNSTABLE
experimental_unstable.definition: Feature-maturity classification for an incomplete, non-authoritative surface that may change incompatibly and is not promoted merely because the product advances to a later release phase.

auxiliary_scripture.label: AUXILIARY_SCRIPTURE
auxiliary_scripture.definition: Inventory/scope compatibility role only. It is never content authority unless a Job explicitly binds the resource to a canonical authority role.

prohibited_ambiguities: Do not use bare REFERENCE without a qualified resource role.
ACT.md is a governed task instruction artifact; model-provider UI modes are not controller concepts.
Do not call generated TARGET output authoritative memory.
Do not describe a work-unit plan as completed analysis.
Do not describe context-only evidence as a normal finding location.
Do not call the BIC lexical donor a REFERENCE; use DONOR or LEXICAL_DONOR.
Do not route existing BIC GENERATED_TARGET Scripture as INSPECT or REWRITE evidence.
Do not expose BIC DONOR verse sequence or passage wording to the model; route only derived lexical evidence.
Do not describe SAW as a generic LRL checker; its primary object is an LWC work-in-progress translation.
